newsitem.title: EGYPT: Shares offered in new Egypt fertiliser firm.
newsitem.headline: Shares offered in new Egypt fertiliser firm.

text.p: Egyptian investors said on Tuesday they were offering the public 136,000 shares, or 34 percent, in a new fertiliser firm at a price of 50 pounds ($14.73) a share.
The public offer of Egypt Fertiliser Company, which is still being established, will be open for two months from August 14, the founders said in a published announcement.
It can be closed after a statutory period of ten days if it is fully subscribed, they added.
All the founders are individuals or private companies.
Investors can apply for a minimum of five shares. A quarter of the share price, 12.5 pounds, and a 0.50 pound issue fee are payable on application.
The Egyptian National Bank is the agent for the sale, the announcement said.
